Team,

Quick ask: Finance is running a mid-cycle reconciliation and flagged a handful of opportunities where the CRM stage doesn’t match the contract/PO signal we have. I’m kicking off a short triage to lock down the EMEA/APAC commit line for next quarter.

Please do the following by EOD Tue 2027-03-02 (48 hours):
- Review the accounts assigned to you in the attached export (Acme_Q3_pipeline_export.csv).
- For each row, confirm one of: Commit / Best Case / At Risk. If you select Commit, include a single-line justification (signed SOW, PO, verbal + legal email).
- Flag any finance blockers (pricing concessions >10%, required SOW changes, billing region conflicts).

Finance will treat anything labeled Commit as part of the certified forecast if we have internal sign-off by Thu 2027-03-04. I’ll collate replies and run a short call if there are >3 disputed deals.

Notable asks up front: AcmeCorp (RDW-EU-2345) currently shows as Proposal in CRM but legal says there’s an external SOW in final review. Markus — can you confirm the expected SOW signature date?

Thanks — keep replies short (one line per account).

Best,
Naomi

-Markus
